judging_criterion.PASS: Every assertion in the bullet has documented support in the frozen 8-file package (directly, or indirectly through an explicitly cited evidence ID, commit, trace or test), and the bullet does not materially imply an unsupported result (native/MPC win, measured comparison, production use, calibration, SLO guarantee, completed native loop or clean-checkout reproduction).
judging_criterion.FAIL: At least one assertion has no in-package support (UNSUPPORTED_IN_PACKAGE) or the wording materially implies an unsupported result (MISLEADING). A FAIL bullet must not be used as written; the smallest correction is given.

support_classes.DIRECT: stated by an accepted evidence ID, acceptance/result index or E1 archive reference in the package
support_classes.INDIRECT: follows from cited evidence without being stated as such (acceptable for PASS)

support_classes.MISLEADING: contradicted by, or implying a result explicitly absent from, the package (FAIL)

judging_criterion.B_independence: Known-missing deliverable-B evidence is never an A FAIL by itself; only wording that implies B results is.
